API Abdul Kalam, often referred to as the "People's President," was an Indian scientist and statesman
who served as the 11th President of India from 2002 to 2007. Born into a poor family in
Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu, he rose to become a key figure in India's space and defense programs,
earning him the moniker "Missile Man of India". Beyond his scientific achievements, Kalam was a

passionate advocate for education, particularly inspiring youth to pursue their dreams and contribute
to national development.
